Form 1612 (Urdu): Police verification for property - renting, leasing or sale (len-den aur kiraya). Written in Urdu; summary added by hand because no Urdu OCR was available.
Sections:
1. Police station, full address of the property, electricity / gas meter numbers, purpose (hiring, sale, lease, rent, pagri) and period of agreement.
2. Tenant details: name and parentage, caste, nationality, CNIC number, passport number, profession, vehicles (motorcycle, car, rickshaw) with registration details, present, permanent and previous addresses, purpose of previous stay, mobile phone, and full details of family members / employees.
3. Property owner details: name and parentage, caste, nationality, CNIC, passport, profession, mobile, present and permanent address, details of other property, signature.
4. Property dealer details: name and parentage, CNIC, passport, mobile, present and previous address, signature.
5. Local guarantor 1 (numberdar / councillor) and local guarantor 2: name and parentage, CNIC, phone, present and permanent address, reason for guarantee, and an undertaking to produce the person if required.
6. Police verification: police certify the particulars, or record that the persons were not found in the area of the police station.
